        <div id="cc-matrix-1780861213"><div id="cc-m-7054561913" class="j-module n j-header "><h1 class="" id="cc-m-header-7054561913">Kitesurfing On Rhodes</h1></div><div id="cc-m-7054562013" class="j-module n j-header "><h2 class="" id="cc-m-header-7054562013">19.-26.06.2027</h2></div><div id="cc-m-7054562113" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 5px;">
</div>
</div><div id="cc-m-7054562213" class="j-module n j-text "><p>
    The beautiful Greek island offers great consistent wind, amazing kite spots and a lot of good vibes for you. If you are looking for an amazing week of kitesurfing with some like-minded
    girls, join us for an unforgettable kite trip to Rhodes!
</p></div><div id="cc-m-7054562313" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 5px;">

</div><div id="cc-m-7054563613" class="j-module n j-header "><h3 class="" id="cc-m-header-7054563613">Spot: Kitesurfing On Rhodes</h3></div><div id="cc-m-7054563713" class="j-module n j-textWithImage "><figure class="cc-imagewrapper cc-m-image-align-1">
<img srcset="https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=320x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i409e4b570392aa6a/version/1667483473/colombia-kiteboarding-in-amazing-flat-water-lagoons-just-with-girls-perfect-and-safe-holiday-in-latin-america.jpg 320w, https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=470x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i409e4b570392aa6a/version/1667483473/colombia-kiteboarding-in-amazing-flat-water-lagoons-just-with-girls-perfect-and-safe-holiday-in-latin-america.jpg 470w, https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=640x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i409e4b570392aa6a/version/1667483473/colombia-kiteboarding-in-amazing-flat-water-lagoons-just-with-girls-perfect-and-safe-holiday-in-latin-america.jpg 640w, https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=940x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i409e4b570392aa6a/version/1667483473/colombia-kiteboarding-in-amazing-flat-water-lagoons-just-with-girls-perfect-and-safe-holiday-in-latin-america.jpg 940w" sizes="(min-width: 470px) 470px, 100vw" id="cc-m-textwithimage-image-7054563713" src="https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=470x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i409e4b570392aa6a/version/1667483473/colombia-kiteboarding-in-amazing-flat-water-lagoons-just-with-girls-perfect-and-safe-holiday-in-latin-america.jpg" alt="Colombia: kiteboarding in amazing flat water lagoons just with girls. Perfect and safe holiday in Latin America!" class="" data-src-width="1600" data-src-height="1000" data-src="https://image.jimcdn.com/app/cms/image/transf/dimension=470x1024:format=jpg/path/s183aa3356785f9d3/image/i409e4b570392aa6a/version/1667483473/colombia-kiteboarding-in-amazing-flat-water-lagoons-just-with-girls-perfect-and-safe-holiday-in-latin-america.jpg" data-image-id="4442571713"/>    
</figure>
<div>
    <div id="cc-m-textwithimage-7054563713" data-name="text" data-action="text" class="cc-m-textwithimage-inline-rte">
        <p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US">While searching for the perfect kite spot for you we came across Kremasti, a little village close to Rhodes Town, that has everything we were looking for.
    Kremasti Beach offers constant and safe side shore winds, perfect for beginners as well as advanced kitesurfers. Our partner <a href="https://www.kiteprocenter.gr/" target="_blank" title="https://www.kiteprocenter.gr/">Air Riders Kite Pro Center</a></span><span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US"> provides storages, rental, rescue service, a comfortable terrace to relax in between
    sessions as well as all the facilities you need for a perfect day at the beach.</span>
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US">If you are looking for beautiful blue water, reliable winds and a safe environment to bring your kitesurfing skills to the next level – this is definitely the
    right spot for you!</span>
</p>

<div>
    <div id="cc-m-textwithimage-7054564013" data-name="text" data-action="text" class="cc-m-textwithimage-inline-rte">
        <p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US">From the airport to the water in less than 15 minutes! Rhodes is easy to reach from nearly every European airport. After your arrival you can get a cab
    to our beachfront accommodation in Kremasti or ask us to arrange a transfer for you. </span>
</p>    </div>

</div><div id="cc-m-7054564213" class="j-module n j-header "><h3 class="" id="cc-m-header-7054564213">Action</h3></div><div id="cc-m-7054564313" class="j-module n j-textWithImage "><figure class="cc-imagewrapper cc-m-image-align-1">

<div>
    <div id="cc-m-textwithimage-7054564313" data-name="text" data-action="text" class="cc-m-textwithimage-inline-rte">
        <p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US">Ready for action? Our mornings start with a body &amp; mind workout (yoga flows, stretching, pain free fascia, meditation exercises, etc.) to provide a
    vitalizing start into the day. Depending on the conditions, we have one to two daily kitesurfing sessions - and we will support you in every step: Gaining more confidence on the water as
    well as boosting your kitesurfing skills and learning some new tricks. Our retreat provides a simple guide to an active and healthy way of living with empowerment activities and
    personal development workshops. </span>
</p>    </div>
</div>

</div><div id="cc-m-7054564513" class="j-module n j-header "><h3 class="" id="cc-m-header-7054564513">Empowerment</h3></div><div id="cc-m-7054564613" class="j-module n j-textWithImage "><figure class="cc-imagewrapper cc-m-image-align-1">

</figure>
<div>
    <div id="cc-m-textwithimage-7054564613" data-name="text" data-action="text" class="cc-m-textwithimage-inline-rte">
        <p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US">More than a kite camp: We focus on empowering women on and off the water. Together we celebrate every day, session and progression, share thoughts and
    experiences to be able to grow. During the past years we found a very special energy unlocked in a group of like-minded women with the same passion – an energy that is supportive and simply
    unstoppable. Our mission is to build a strong sisterhood of kite girls (and those, who want to become one) to show the world how much women rock on the water! </span>
</p>    </div>

</div><div id="cc-m-7054565613" class="j-module n j-text "><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US">Limited spots for the most personal experience. Feel free to send us a message regarding information about the spot, transfer, kite lessons, rental – or
    anything else, that’s on your mind. </span>
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US"> </span>
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <b>Which kite level do I need?</b>
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US"> </span>
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US">At our workshops, all kitesurfing levels are welcome! Please note that due to safety reasons you have to take kiteboarding lessons or assistance until you
    are <b>able to go upwind in any kind of condition</b> (light wind, strong wind, gusts, wavy spots, etc.) and be completely confident with the <b>self-rescue maneuver</b>. We are
    happy to help you arrange everything with our partner school <a href="https://www.kiteprocenter.gr/" target="_blank" title="https://www.kiteprocenter.gr/">Air Riders Kite Pro
    Center</a></span><span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US"> prior the trip, where you'll get a 15% discount on all services as part of the My Salty Sisters retreat. Even if you are a beginner or
    need some refreshment lessons, we will still make sure to ride together and share amazing experiences on the water.</span>
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US"> </span>
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <b>What is the difference between a My Salty Sisters Empowerment &amp; Kite Retreat and a kite camp?</b>
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US"> </span>
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US">We want to shift the focus to the one thing that matters most: having fun on the water. We truly believe that progression comes with the feeling of safety,
    support and pure joy – and that’s what we want to provide to our Salty Sisters. Empowering each other is a big part of this process, which means we will be there for every little step you do
    towards reaching your personal (kitesurfing) goal.</span>
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US"> </span>
</p>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 21pt; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">
    <span lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US">Are you ready for a kitesurf vacation you will never forget?</span>
</p>
